name: LobsterAI
description: Open-source, desktop-grade AI agent that gets real work done — data analysis, slides, docs, video & web research. Built on OpenClaw; runs tools on your real desktop and takes commands from your phone via WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk & Telegram.
readmeExcerpt:
# LobsterAI **The open-source desktop AI agent that does real work on your computer.** Describe a task in plain language. LobsterAI reads your files, runs tools, drives a browser,
edits Office documents, and hands back finished work — at your desk or from your phone.

**English** · [简体中文](README_zh.md)

Download  ·  Quick start  ·  Features  ·  Build from source  ·  Community

## Why LobsterAI Most AI assistants stop at an answer. LobsterAI is built to finish the job. - **It works where your work lives.** Point it at a folder and it reads spreadsheets, writes documents, runs scripts, and browses the web, asking before anything sensitive. - **You see the result, not just a reply.** Web pages, charts, images, videos, PDFs, and Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files open in a side panel, ready to edit or share. - **It keeps working when you step away.** Schedule recurring jobs, or message your desktop agent from WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, Telegram, and more. - **It's yours.** MIT-licensed, with sessions stored locally. Sign in to use the built-in models, or bring your own API keys. Built by [NetEase Youdao](https://www.youdao.com/), LobsterAI is the first open-source desktop-grade agent from a major Chinese tech company. ## Features

Native Office editing
Open Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files right in the app. Edit by hand, or let the agent make changes live alongside you.

Kits, skills, and connectors
Install role-based kits for engineering, design, finance, sales, and more, pick individual skills, or connect MCP servers.

Scheduled tasks
Turn any prompt into a recurring job: morning briefs, end-of-day wrap-ups, weekly reports, and health checks.

Message it from anywhere
Connect a chat app once, then send tasks to your desktop agent from your phone.
### Everything in the box | Capability | What you get | | --- | --- | | **Cowork sessions** | Long-running tasks on local projects with streaming progress, a tool timeline, session forks, and approval prompts before file, shell, or network actions. | | **Artifacts and sharing** | Live previews for HTML, SVG, Mermaid, images, video, Markdown, code, PDF, and Office files. Edit images in place and share results as a link. | | **Built-in browser** | An in-app browser the agent can drive, with tabs, saved logins, and passkey support, for research and web workflows. | | **Computer use** | Let the agent operate desktop apps on Windows x64 and macOS 13 or later. | | **Multiple agents** | Create agents with their own identity, model, skills, and working folder, add ready-made experts from the Expert Plaza, and bind agents to chat channels. | | **Skills** | Built-in skills for documents, spreadsheets, slides, PDFs, web search, browser automation, image and video generation, stock research, writing, email, and more. See [`SKILLs/`](SKILLs). | | **MCP connectors** | Add local or remote MCP servers from the marketplace, sign in with OAuth, and choose which tools each server exposes. | | **IM channels** | WeChat, WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu/Lark, QQ, NetEase IM, NetEase Bee, POPO, Telegram, Discord, and email. Multi-instance platforms can route each bot to a different agent. | | **Desktop companion** | A floating orb for quick tasks, screenshots, and actions on selected text, such as translating or reading aloud. | | **Memory and Dreaming** | Durable memory files, plus optional scheduled "Dreaming" runs that consolidate what the agent learned, so preferences carry across sessions. | | **Models** | Built-in models (DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, MiniMax, and more) after sign-in, or your own keys for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, xAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. | | **Library** | Every file your agents create, collected in one place across sessions, both local and shared. | ## Things to try | Scenario | Example prompt | | --- | --- | | Build a local tool | "I still track inventory and sales in Excel. Build a local inventory system that records purchases and sales, calculates stock and profit, and opens in my browser." | | Analyze local data | "Use `product-growth.xlsx` to build a visual dashboard and summarize the main growth drivers." | | Make a deck | "Research the AI agent market and turn the findings into a presentation." | | Check a web dashboard | "Open the ads dashboard every morning, check spend and conversion anomalies, and summarize likely causes." | | Screen documents | "Turn the resumes in this folder into a screening sheet and shortlist the strongest candidates against the JD." | | Run scheduled work | "Every weekday at 9 AM, collect yesterday's AI news and send me a concise digest." | ## Quick start 1. **Install LobsterAI.** Download it from the [official website](https://lobsterai.youdao.com/#/download-list), or get the latest release directly: [macOS (Apple Silicon)](https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI/releases/latest/download/LobsterAI--mac-arm64.dmg) · [macOS (Intel)](https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI/releases/latest/download/LobsterAI--mac-x64.dmg) · [Windows x64](https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI/releases/latest/download/LobsterAI--win-x64.exe) 2. **Choose a model.** Sign in to use the built-in models, or add your own API key under **Settings → Custom Model**. 3. **Give it a task.** Pick a working folder, describe what you want, and approve actions as it works. Generated files open in the side panel. 4. **Go further.** Install kits from **Kits · Skills · Connectors**, set up recurring work in **Scheduled Tasks**, or connect a chat app under **Settings → IM Bot**. ## How it works ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph App["LobsterAI desktop app (Electron)"] UI["Renderer
React · Redux · Tailwind
sessions · artifacts · Office editors"] Main["Main process
Cowork sessions · permissions · SQLite
skills · MCP · IM · scheduler"] UI <-->|"preload IPC"| Main end Main <-->|"config sync · events"| Gateway["OpenClaw gateway
bundled agent runtime"] Gateway --> Models["LLM providers"] Gateway --> Tools["Local tools
files · shell · browser
computer use · MCP servers"] Chat["Chat apps
WeChat · Feishu · DingTalk · Telegram …"] <--> Gateway ``` - **Cowork** is LobsterAI's product layer. It owns sessions, messages, permissions, artifacts, agents, and IM bindings, and stores them locally in SQLite. - **[OpenClaw](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw)** is the agent runtime underneath. LobsterAI ships a pinned build, renders its config from app state, and translates its events into the Cowork stream. - The renderer is sandboxed with context isolation and talks to the main process only through the preload IPC bridge. ## Build from source Requirements: Node.js `>=24.15.0 <25`, npm `>=11.17.0 <12`, git, and pnpm. ```bash git clone https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI.git cd LobsterAI npm install # First run: fetches the pinned OpenClaw version into ../openclaw, builds the runtime, and starts the app npm run electron:dev:openclaw # Later runs, once the runtime exists npm run electron:dev ``` [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) covers tests, linting, runtime options, packaging installers, and the project layout. ## Security and privacy - Sessions, messages, and settings are stored locally in `lobsterai.sqlite` under the app's user data directory. Agent memory and runtime state live alongside it under `openclaw/`. - File operations, shell commands, and network access are permission-gated, and the agent asks before it acts. - Renderer windows run with context isolation, sandboxing, and no Node.js integration. ## Community Join the WeChat group for help, feedback, and release news. You can also follow [@LobsterAIYoudao](https://x.com/LobsterAIYoudao) on X. Report bugs and request features through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI/issues/new/choose). ## Contributing Contributions are welcome. Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) to set up your environment, and look for [good first issues](https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22good%20first%20issue%22) to get started. ## Star history ## License [MIT](LICENSE) © NetEase Youdao
readmeHtml:
LobsterAI

The open-source desktop AI agent that does real work on your computer.

Describe a task in plain language. LobsterAI reads your files, runs tools, drives a browser,
edits Office documents, and hands back finished work — at your desk or from your phone.

English · 简体中文

Download  ·  Quick start  ·  Features  ·  Build from source  ·  Community

Why LobsterAI

Most AI assistants stop at an answer. LobsterAI is built to finish the job.

  • It works where your work lives. Point it at a folder and it reads spreadsheets, writes documents, runs scripts, and browses the web, asking before anything sensitive.
  • You see the result, not just a reply. Web pages, charts, images, videos, PDFs, and Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files open in a side panel, ready to edit or share.
  • It keeps working when you step away. Schedule recurring jobs, or message your desktop agent from WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, Telegram, and more.
  • It's yours. MIT-licensed, with sessions stored locally. Sign in to use the built-in models, or bring your own API keys.

Built by NetEase Youdao, LobsterAI is the first open-source desktop-grade agent from a major Chinese tech company.

Features

Native Office editing
Open Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files right in the app. Edit by hand, or let the agent make changes live alongside you.

Kits, skills, and connectors
Install role-based kits for engineering, design, finance, sales, and more, pick individual skills, or connect MCP servers.

Scheduled tasks
Turn any prompt into a recurring job: morning briefs, end-of-day wrap-ups, weekly reports, and health checks.

Message it from anywhere
Connect a chat app once, then send tasks to your desktop agent from your phone.

Everything in the box

Capability What you get
Cowork sessions Long-running tasks on local projects with streaming progress, a tool timeline, session forks, and approval prompts before file, shell, or network actions.
Artifacts and sharing Live previews for HTML, SVG, Mermaid, images, video, Markdown, code, PDF, and Office files. Edit images in place and share results as a link.
Built-in browser An in-app browser the agent can drive, with tabs, saved logins, and passkey support, for research and web workflows.
Computer use Let the agent operate desktop apps on Windows x64 and macOS 13 or later.
Multiple agents Create agents with their own identity, model, skills, and working folder, add ready-made experts from the Expert Plaza, and bind agents to chat channels.
Skills Built-in skills for documents, spreadsheets, slides, PDFs, web search, browser automation, image and video generation, stock research, writing, email, and more. See SKILLs/.
MCP connectors Add local or remote MCP servers from the marketplace, sign in with OAuth, and choose which tools each server exposes.
IM channels WeChat, WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu/Lark, QQ, NetEase IM, NetEase Bee, POPO, Telegram, Discord, and email. Multi-instance platforms can route each bot to a different agent.
Desktop companion A floating orb for quick tasks, screenshots, and actions on selected text, such as translating or reading aloud.
Memory and Dreaming Durable memory files, plus optional scheduled "Dreaming" runs that consolidate what the agent learned, so preferences carry across sessions.
Models Built-in models (DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, MiniMax, and more) after sign-in, or your own keys for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, xAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
Library Every file your agents create, collected in one place across sessions, both local and shared.

Things to try

Scenario Example prompt
Build a local tool "I still track inventory and sales in Excel. Build a local inventory system that records purchases and sales, calculates stock and profit, and opens in my browser."
Analyze local data "Use product-growth.xlsx to build a visual dashboard and summarize the main growth drivers."
Make a deck "Research the AI agent market and turn the findings into a presentation."
Check a web dashboard "Open the ads dashboard every morning, check spend and conversion anomalies, and summarize likely causes."
Screen documents "Turn the resumes in this folder into a screening sheet and shortlist the strongest candidates against the JD."
Run scheduled work "Every weekday at 9 AM, collect yesterday's AI news and send me a concise digest."

Quick start

  1. Install LobsterAI. Download it from the official website, or get the latest release directly: macOS (Apple Silicon) · macOS (Intel) · Windows x64
  2. Choose a model. Sign in to use the built-in models, or add your own API key under Settings → Custom Model.
  3. Give it a task. Pick a working folder, describe what you want, and approve actions as it works. Generated files open in the side panel.
  4. Go further. Install kits from Kits · Skills · Connectors, set up recurring work in Scheduled Tasks, or connect a chat app under Settings → IM Bot.

How it works

flowchart LR
  subgraph App["LobsterAI desktop app (Electron)"]
    UI["Renderer<br/>React · Redux · Tailwind<br/>sessions · artifacts · Office editors"]
    Main["Main process<br/>Cowork sessions · permissions · SQLite<br/>skills · MCP · IM · scheduler"]
    UI <-->|"preload IPC"| Main
  end
  Main <-->|"config sync · events"| Gateway["OpenClaw gateway<br/>bundled agent runtime"]
  Gateway --> Models["LLM providers"]
  Gateway --> Tools["Local tools<br/>files · shell · browser<br/>computer use · MCP servers"]
  Chat["Chat apps<br/>WeChat · Feishu · DingTalk · Telegram …"] <--> Gateway
Loading
  • Cowork is LobsterAI's product layer. It owns sessions, messages, permissions, artifacts, agents, and IM bindings, and stores them locally in SQLite.
  • OpenClaw is the agent runtime underneath. LobsterAI ships a pinned build, renders its config from app state, and translates its events into the Cowork stream.
  • The renderer is sandboxed with context isolation and talks to the main process only through the preload IPC bridge.

Build from source

Requirements: Node.js >=24.15.0 <25, npm >=11.17.0 <12, git, and pnpm.

git clone https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI.git
cd LobsterAI
npm install

# First run: fetches the pinned OpenClaw version into ../openclaw, builds the runtime, and starts the app
npm run electron:dev:openclaw

# Later runs, once the runtime exists
npm run electron:dev

CONTRIBUTING.md covers tests, linting, runtime options, packaging installers, and the project layout.

Security and privacy

  • Sessions, messages, and settings are stored locally in lobsterai.sqlite under the app's user data directory. Agent memory and runtime state live alongside it under openclaw/.
  • File operations, shell commands, and network access are permission-gated, and the agent asks before it acts.
  • Renderer windows run with context isolation, sandboxing, and no Node.js integration.

Community

Join the WeChat group for help, feedback, and release news. You can also follow @LobsterAIYoudao on X.

Report bugs and request features through GitHub Issues.

Contributing

Contributions are welcome. Read CONTRIBUTING.md to set up your environment, and look for good first issues to get started.

Star history

License

MIT © NetEase Youdao

releases.body:
This release brings image editing into your conversations, makes remote tools easier to connect, and gives you clearer visibility into usage. It also improves startup reliability, browser tasks, and account recovery.

## ✨ Highlights

### Edit images without leaving your conversation

Annotate images with drawings, arrows, shapes, and text, or select an area and describe what you want to change. With a compatible image model, you can remove backgrounds, erase objects, and expand images to a new aspect ratio.

Save annotated copies or send your edits to AI. Conversation snapshots preserve the source image, selections, and annotations so you can revisit your instructions.

[#2907](https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI/pull/2907)

### Connect remote tools with less setup

Install remote MCP connectors from the marketplace and connect through browser-based OAuth or guided credential forms. Supporting services can now be authorized without manually copying API keys.

[#2905](https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI/pull/2905) · [#2909](https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI/pull/2909)

### More options for custom models

Custom providers now support Ope

releases.name: LobsterAI 2026.10.13
releases.body:
## What’s Changed

This release introduces Office document editing, Computer Use support for macOS, and improved MCP tool management. It also brings a refreshed interface, a smoother task experience, and significant improvements to OpenClaw stability and reliability.

✨ Highlights

* Office Document Editing — Create and edit Word, Excel, and PowerPoint documents directly in LobsterAI, with support for manual editing, AI-assisted updates, and automatic saving.
* Computer Use for Mac — AI can now interact with desktop applications on both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
* MCP Tool Picker — Search, browse, and select which MCP tools to enable, with estimated token usage for better context management.
* Refreshed UI — Updated colors, layouts, agent views, and task interactions for a cleaner and more consistent experience.
* Improved Agent Reliability — More robust OpenClaw gateway startup, configuration recovery, model responses, and task execution.

aiSummary.oneLiner: Open-source desktop agent capable of executing real OS workflows and responding to mobile messaging commands.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: LobsterAI is a highly capable, desktop-grade AI agent robustly built on the OpenClaw framework that interacts directly with a user's operating system to perform complex tasks. It flawlessly executes real, intensive desktop operations—such as analyzing data, compiling web research, and generating detailed slide decks—by directly controlling native applications. Uniquely, it seamlessly bridges the traditional desktop environment with mobile interfaces by readily accepting remote commands. It heavily supports popular messaging platforms like WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, and Telegram to execute background tasks incredibly seamlessly from anywhere.
keyFeatures: Native OS control: Interfaces completely directly with the desktop environment to smoothly operate native applications and complex workflows.
Cross-platform messaging: Receives complex task prompts and direct commands remotely via WeChat, Telegram, Feishu, and DingTalk.
Automated research capabilities: Conducts highly comprehensive web searches and intelligently compiles findings into highly structured documents.
Intelligent data processing: Highly capable of ingesting raw data files and independently outputting sophisticated analytical reports or slide presentations.
OpenClaw architecture: Built heavily on a specialized framework expressly designed for highly reliable, persistent OS-level agent execution.
Scheduled task management: Allows users to securely create highly recurring work either by conversation or through a dedicated UI.

useCases.title: Automated document generation
useCases.description: Instructing the agent remotely to independently process a folder of raw data and autonomously build a highly professional presentation slide deck.

useCases.title: Multi-modal desktop workflows
useCases.description: Bridging vital communication flawlessly between mobile messaging apps and heavy desktop applications without ever requiring any human intervention.

useCases.title: Background task delegation
useCases.description: Assigning incredibly time-consuming web research tasks directly to the local machine while actively away from the keyboard.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Knowledge workers, dedicated researchers, and serious automation enthusiasts wanting to remotely control their desktop machines to execute complex operational tasks. It provides extreme flexibility for users who operate primarily on mobile.
